pages.text: A product combining dark magic and machinery. Right-click to bind a $(l:goetymech_machines/stress_reader)Stress Reader$(/l); once bound, it can output the stress of the bound network across dimensions. Sneak + right-click to unbind.$(br)If a $(l:goetymech_machines/stress_ark)Stress Ark$(/l) exists, the engine does not need to be bound individually — the ark will automatically assign an available reader network to the engine upon placement.$(br)$(4)"A new expression of magic — we no longer merely harness magical power."$()
